# docker_buildx_bake (Action)

Builds one or more targets from a bake definition, like `docker buildx bake`. The definition comes from HCL, JSON or compose files and/or inline `content`; groups, targets, `inherits`, `matrix`, variables (overridden by `variables`), user functions and the bake standard library are resolved as the buildx bake reference describes, then every target is built through BuildKit on the selected builder. The result object holds the resolved definition (`bake --print`), the per-target metadata (`--metadata-file`), tags, digests and build refs. Images are not tracked in state; use `docker_image` for images Terraform should own.

Actions require Terraform 1.14 or later. An action keeps no state: it runs when
a resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [...] actions = [action.docker_buildx_bake.<name>] } }`
fires, or on demand with `terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_buildx_bake.<name>`.
Arguments go in the action's `config` block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "release_version" {
  type    = string
  default = "1.0.0"
}

resource "terraform_data" "release" {
  input = var.release_version

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_buildx_bake.release]
    }
  }
}

# Builds the "release" group of a bake definition and pushes it. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_buildx_bake.release
action "docker_buildx_bake" "release" {
  config {
    working_dir = path.module
    content     = <<-EOT
      variable "VERSION" {
        default = "dev"
      }

      group "release" {
        targets = ["app", "worker"]
      }

      target "_common" {
        args      = { VERSION = VERSION }
        platforms = ["linux/amd64", "linux/arm64"]
      }

      target "app" {
        inherits = ["_common"]
        context  = "app"
        tags     = ["registry.example.com/app:$${VERSION}"]
      }

      target "worker" {
        inherits = ["_common"]
        context  = "worker"
        tags     = ["registry.example.com/worker:$${VERSION}"]
      }
    EOT
    targets     = ["release"]
    variables   = { VERSION = var.release_version }
    push        = true
    result_path = "${path.module}/out/bake-result.json"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `builder` (String) Builder to build on (`--builder`): `default` (the daemon's BuildKit, the default) or the name of a docker-container builder, e.g. `docker_buildx_builder.ci.name`.
- `content` (String) Inline bake definition, HCL or JSON (detected by a leading `{`), merged after `files`.
- `files` (List of String) Bake files to read, in merge order (`--file`): `.hcl`, `.json` or compose `.yml`/`.yaml`. Without `files` and `content`, the files bake looks for (`compose.yaml` ... `docker-bake.override.hcl`) are read from `working_dir`.
- `load` (Boolean) Whether to load every target's image into the daemon (`--load`, `*.output=type=docker`).
- `no_cache` (Boolean) Whether to build without the build cache (`--no-cache`).
- `provenance` (String) Provenance attestation for every target (`--provenance`): `min`, `max` or `false`.
- `pull` (Boolean) Whether to always pull referenced images (`--pull`).
- `push` (Boolean) Whether to push every target's tags (`--push`, `*.output=type=registry`).
- `result_path` (String) Local file the action writes its result object to after a successful run. The file holds one JSON object keyed by the action's output names (`result`, the identity values, the raw outputs with their `*_sha256` hashes, and the version values), with keys sorted at every level, two-space indentation and a trailing newline; it is written atomically (temporary file, then rename) and parent directories are created. Read it in a later run with `jsondecode(file(...))` or the `local_file` data source. Sensitive values are written in full, since this is your own file, but show as `(sensitive)` in the progress message. Nothing is written when the action fails.
- `sbom` (Boolean) Whether to add an SBOM attestation to every target (`--sbom`).
- `set` (Map of String) Map of target attribute overrides (`--set`), keyed `<target>.<attribute>[.<key>]`; `<target>` may be `*` or a glob. Examples: `"*.platform" = "linux/amd64,linux/arm64"`, `"app.args.VERSION" = "1.2"`, `"*.push" = "true"`. List values take several entries separated by `;`.
- `targets` (List of String) Targets or groups to build. Default `["default"]` (the only target when the definition has one and no `default`).
- `variables` (Map of String) Map of variable name to override value, where bake reads environment variables: primitives as text, lists and sets as CSV, other types as JSON (or JSON for any typed variable under `<NAME>_JSON`). Every key must be a declared variable. The provider's environment is never read.
- `working_dir` (String) Directory that relative bake file paths, contexts, secret and SSH paths are resolved against. Default: Terraform's working directory, as buildx uses its current directory. Use `path.module` to resolve from the module.
